backend/main.mo: Main actor defining types (Report, Pharmacy, Pharmacist, RegulatoryBody, etc.) and state management for reports, authorities, education content, and regulatory bodies with authorization and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms OldRegulatoryBody records to NewRegulatoryBody by adding optional address and helpline fields, setting them to null during migration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two features: updating RegulatoryBodyCard to display address field with location icon, and adding i18n translation keys for regulatory bodies sections and descriptions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities for the pharmacy verification application with i18n support and regulatory bodies display.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for emerald-green primary colors suitable for healthcare applications.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the 'Know Your Pharmacy' application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for all pages including regulatory-bodies, wrapping providers for QueryClient, InternetIdentity, Theme, Language, and conditional Onboarding display.
frontend/src/components/CameraCapture.ts: Reusable camera capture dialog component with video preview, error handling, camera switching, and photo capture functionality that returns captured image as File to parent component.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSwitcher: Dropdown menu component for language selection showing English as active and Hindi as coming soon (disabled).
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component providing the app shell with sticky header, navigation (desktop and mobile sheet menu), logo, language switcher, network status indicator, login button, and footer with social links and copyright.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that toggles between login and logout states, handles Internet Identity authentication flow, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/NetworkStatusInd: Displays an alert banner when the user is offline using the useNetworkStatus hook; hidden when online.
frontend/src/components/Onboarding.tsx: Multi-step onboarding flow (purpose, disclaimer, terms) with illustrations and checkboxes, completing onboarding via useOnboarding hook when terms are accepted.
frontend/src/components/RegulatoryBodyCa: Card component displaying regulatory body details (name, state, address, email, phone, website) with quick action buttons for contacting via email or visiting website.
frontend/src/components/UserProfileSetup: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name (required), email, and phone (optional), saving via useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/constants/indianStates.ts: Exports an array of all Indian states and union territories for use in dropdowns and forms.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches a backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Hook for capturing user's GPS coordinates using the browser Geolocation API, handling permissions, errors, and loading states.
frontend/src/hooks/useHasReports.ts: Determines if the user has any reports by checking backend reports for authenticated users or localStorage for guest users.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Custom React hook that monitors browser online/offline status using navigator.onLine and window events.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboarding.ts: Manages onboarding completion state in localStorage with cross-tab synchronization via storage events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles and report creation, including image compression and mapping of pharmacy/pharmacist data to backend format with ExternalBlob handling.
frontend/src/i18n/i18n.tsx: Implements i18n context provider with language switching (en/hi), localStorage persistence, and nested key translation function.
frontend/src/i18n/README.md: Documentation stub for the i18n system supporting English (implemented) and Hindi (ready), referencing translations.ts and i18n.tsx files.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Contains English translation strings for the entire app including onboarding, navigation, pharmacy/pharmacist checking, education, and regulatory body content.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors, including sidebar, chart, and semantic color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/CheckPharmacist.tsx: Page for capturing pharmacist details (name, registration number, state, photo) with optional 'unknown details' mode, validates input and navigates to presence check with collected data.
frontend/src/pages/CheckPharmacy.tsx: Form page for entering pharmacy details (name, address, state, license number) with optional GPS location capture; navigates to check-pharmacist page with collected data.
frontend/src/pages/Education.tsx: Displays educational content and FAQ about pharmacist roles and regulations using accordion components; fetches content from backend via useEducationContent hook.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page with hero image and navigation cards for checking pharmacy, reporting issues, education, and viewing reports (if any exist).
frontend/src/pages/MyReports.tsx: Lists user's saved reports with options to export as formatted complaint email, delete, or submit complaint; shows empty state if no reports exist.
frontend/src/pages/PresenceCheck.tsx: Multi-question form checking pharmacist presence, who is dispensing, and observation time with photo capture and auto GPS; navigates to report-details with collected observation data.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static page displaying privacy policy sections including data collection, usage, storage, user rights, and contact information using translated content.
frontend/src/pages/RegulatoryBodies.tsx: Displays regulatory bodies grouped by type (national, state, consumer) using cards. Fetches data via useRegulatoryBodies hook and shows loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetails.tsx: Form page for creating a report with pharmacy, pharmacist, and observation details. Allows users to select issues, add custom notes, and submit contact information before saving the report.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page with privacy policy/terms links and a button to clear local data. Includes confirmation dialog for destructive actions.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitComplaint.tsx: Displays recommended authorities for a report and provides buttons to send pre-formatted complaint emails or visit authority websites. Fetches report and authority data based on reportId and state.
frontend/src/pages/TermsOfService.tsx: Static page displaying terms of service content with sections for service description, responsibilities, disclaimers, limitations, and governing law using translation keys.
Formats a Report object into a structured plain-text email body containing pharmacy details, pharmacist info, observations, issues, and reporter contact information.
frontend/src/utils/imageCompression.ts: Compresses image files to JPEG format with max dimensions of 1920x1080 and 80% quality using HTML5 Canvas API.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, custom animations (accordion), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata for "Know Your Pharmacy" app describing a Flutter mobile app with Node.js backend for verifying pharmacy/pharmacist details and generating complaints, including architectural notes, known issues (onboarding navigation bug), and existing feature list.
